name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
summary: A voluntary contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers that provides a assured monthly pension of Rs. 3000 after the age of 60.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be a farmer.
The applicant must be between 18 and 40 years of age.

entitlement_rules.text: The subscriber receives an assured monthly pension of Rs. 3000 after attaining the age of 60.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the enrolment centre.

appeal_hierarchy.authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
